newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ Bank raises fixed NZ mtg rates, holds variable.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Bank raises fixed NZ mtg rates, holds variable.

text.p: ANZ Bank and Postbank, both owned by ANZ Banking Group (New Zealand) Ltd, said on Wednesday they were raising their fixed mortgage rates across the range of one- to five-year periods but holding the variable mortgage rate both banks offer at 9.95 percent.
In a statement the group said it would raise its one-year fixed rate to 9.4 percent, its two-year to 9.75 percent and its three- and five-year fixed rates to 9.95 percent.
